correctness.rationale: The horizontal-square chord integration gives the displayed arctangent profile for a>=b>=0,c>0. Its boundary limits b=0, c=0, a=b=0 agree with direct disks/square. The secant integral has denominator c^4+c^2t^2(X+Y)+t^4XY, hence strict balancing when XY falls at fixed X+Y. Along a=b, T(r) is strictly increasing from -4 to 4/3, giving the unique internal minimum and upper endpoint π√2; containing the unit ball gives lower endpoint π, strict except coordinate planes. Brunn concavity plus central symmetry controls affine slices. Independently integrated polar radial areas for eight axes/oblique normals at high angular resolution (error below 3e-8); inspected actual check_sections.py and frozen RESULT.md. No inequality for arbitrary noncentral minimum is claimed.
residual_risks: Equal radii and perpendicular axes only; no unequal-radius or arbitrary affine section profile.
